review_candidates.title: Senior/ Level 2 Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Your Passion. Your Purpose. If you’re here, you’re looking for something more. More opportunity, more impact, more purpose. At Rehmann, each and every one of our associates plays a pivotal role in the Firm’s success. When you join our team, you can count on exceptional support, encouragement, and guidance from your colleagues and from leadership. No matter where you want to go in your career, Rehmann can help you get there. Whether you’re in the early stages of your professional journey or you’re further down your path, we’re focused on helping you achieve your goals – whatever they may be. When you join Rehmann, you are part of a culture that Puts People First and aims to help everyone reach their fullest potential. Let us show you all the ways we can Empower Your Purpose. To learn more about Rehmann, visit: https://www.rehmann.com/careers/ Job Description Job Summary: As a Senior or Level 2 Network Engineer, you will be a subject matter expert and the highest point of escalation for the technology you champion. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-performing, highly available systems to meet our clients' functional and cost requirements. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Fortinet, Watchguard, Cisco, Ruckus, and Microsoft Azure networking technologies and familiarity with offerings from other vendors. As a Senior or Level 2 Network Engineer, you will work closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and provide innovative solutions that align with their business objectives. You will also collaborate with our internal teams to ensure the smooth delivery of projects and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members. Essential Duties/Responsibilities Project-Based Implementations: Perform IT project work for clients, designing and implementing on-premises networking systems as well as co-hosted and cloud networking. Systems Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain high-performing, highly available, and secure network systems including but not limited to switching, routing, firewall, cloud networking, and wireless. Research and Development: Assist in researching and developing potential new offerings that can be delivered through our business models. Actively participate in the evaluation of new technology to enhance our service portfolio and develop implementation plans to add new tech to our stack. Presales Support: Provide presales consultation to business advisors and account managers, including reviewing existing client environments and recommending upgrades or changes. Service Request Management: Efficiently manage service requests, ensuring accurate and detailed updates, including next steps. Schedule, research, resolve, and route service requests as appropriate, escalating based on established processes and timeframes. Time Tracking and Billing: This is a billable role, and time entry and accurate tracking of billable work for clients is critical to our success. Time is entered in our PSA system on tickets and projects and notes must be professional and accurate. Troubleshooting: Provide remote and on-site troubleshooting, utilizing appropriate tools to diagnose and remediate issues with client systems. Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and operation level agreements (OLAs) while adhering to established best practices. Organization: Demonstrate a high level of organization, efficiently handling a variety of tasks and responsibilities while maintaining a high standard of quality. Flexibility: Exhibit the ability to adapt quickly to new topics, technology, and processes to address emerging IT needs and opportunities for our clients. Work schedule may require conformity to client needs and outcomes. Security and Compliance: Implement and maintain robust security measures to protect client data and systems from unauthorized access, breaches, and cyber threats. When applicable, ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations, such as NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS. Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans for clients' systems. Regularly test and update these plans to ensure their effectiveness in the event of an incident. Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Evaluate systems by monitoring system performance, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing optimizations to improve efficiency and reliability. Utilize monitoring tools and analytics to proactively address potential issues before they impact clients. Vendor Management: Liaise with third-party vendors and service providers to ensure seamless integration of their solutions with clients' systems. Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills, effectively conveying technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of computer expertise. Ability to explain complex technical concepts in layman's terms is essential. Teamwork: Actively participate in regular team meetings and status update meetings, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment. Documentation: Document client environments and technical processes, procedures, and solutions for knowledge sharing and future reference. Assist in the creation of user guides, training materials, and technical documentation. On-Call Rotation: Participate in on-call rotation to provide emergency support and resolve critical issues outside of regular business hours. Uphold Rehmann Values: Put people first, be obsessed with client success, cultivate business wisdom, embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, exhibit unwavering integrity. Other duties as assigned to meet client and organizational goals. Required Skills/Abilities Education: High school diploma required. Degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) required. Certifications: Relevant vendor certifications such as Fortinet’s FCP or FCSS, Cisco’s CCNP or CCNA, Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, and/or other vendor certifications are highly desirable. Proven experience designing and implementing robust, scalable, secure, and high-performance networks that meet the unique needs of various clients. Extensive experience with firewalls, wireless access points, routers, switches, and other network technology from leading vendors such as Fortinet, WatchGuard, Ruckus, and Cisco required. In-depth knowledge of Fortinet’s stack preferred, including FortiGate, FortiAP, FortiSwitch, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and other technology. Strong understanding of network protocols, topologies, and architectures, including TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, SD-WAN, ZTNA, DHCP, DNS, and routing protocols. Familiarity with cloud networking in Azure and software-based-networking in VMware and Hyper-V environments. Willingness to travel to client sites as needed, and to work outside of regular business hours when required. As such, must have reliable transportation. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. Strong project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Passion for learning and staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends. Professional certification, such as, OSCP, CEH, PNPT, GPEN, CPTS, eWPT, eWPTX, OSWE, or eCPPT is a plus. Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, GO, C#, C++, or C Understanding of two or more of the following: Active Directory, Cloud Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Web Application Security, and Network Security. Additional Responsibilities Unquestionably sound ethics. Works well in team environment. Excellent written and oral communications skills. Empathy and ability to provide relevant answers suitable to clients/customers at different stages of Services processes. Ability to remain calm and work well under pressure. Manage multiple priorities and deadlines, through disciplined approaches and clear communication. Self-motivated The ability to locate, track, organize and summarize information. Willingness to travel (98% local/state, nationally 2x per year average). Good problem solving and decision-making skills; ability to understand and analyze complex issues. Excellent troubleshooting skills. Adaptable. Able and willing to coach and train others. The ability to build relationships; to ask questions that elicit responses and engage the other in discussion; the ability to introduce and describe relevance at the onset of the engagement and provide summaries to reinforce the message. Sense of humor! How You’ll Make An Impact At Rehmann Assist with vulnerability and penetration testing engagements for clients. Assist with detailed assessments of information technology systems and infrastructures to verify systems are secure and support the related applications or business processes. Evaluating system controls, documenting results, making recommendations, and communicating information to clients. Assist with continuous development and evolution of penetration testing methodology and tool set and web application testing. We Put People First in all that we do. Our associates are our greatest assets and we provide programs and benefits that encourage growth and development and align with their needs and goals. This includes benefits focused on physical and mental health, paid time off for volunteering and diversity-related activities, flexible work arrangements, and more. When you join Rehmann, you become part of a firm dedicated to helping Empower Your Purpose, whatever it may be. Rehmann is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Nice to Have You do not need to check every box, but experience in these areas will help: • CompTIA Network+, Security+, or Microsoft certifications such as MS-900, AZ-900, or MD-102 • NinjaOne RMM, HaloPSA, or similar MSP platforms • VMware, Hyper-V, or other virtualization technologies • Backup and disaster recovery platforms • WatchGuard or comparable firewall administration • CrowdStrike, Huntress, or enterprise EDR/XDR platforms • Microsoft 365 security and Conditional Access • Azure and hybrid Microsoft environments • Experience working within mature MSP processes and service delivery standards Who Thrives Here Our four core values are operational. They describe how we expect people to work and the kind of people who tend to succeed at Tier 3. See It Through You own the result, not just the task. The job is not finished until the outcome is achieved. Own the Mess When something goes wrong, even when you did not cause it, you step in and help make it right. Multiply the Team You share what you know. You teach. You document. You make the people around you better. Lead With Love You remember there is a human being on the other side of every ticket, call, email, and problem - and you treat them accordingly, even when the situation is difficult. Why Tier 3? A job change should be about more than compensation. We want Tier 3 to be a place where great technical people can build a career. You will join a growing company with: • An Inc. 5000-recognized growth story and ambitious plans for the future • Clients across the country and exposure to a wide variety of technologies and environments • A talented technical team that collaborates instead of operating in silos • Leadership that continues investing in people, tools, cybersecurity, automation, and better ways of delivering IT • Challenging technical work that will continue stretching your abilities • Opportunities to lead projects, mentor others, and influence how we operate • A culture where we take our work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously • A team that works hard, enjoys working together, and celebrates wins together • The opportunity to play an important role in where Tier 3 goes next Our Commitment to You • $75,000–$95,000 annual compensation, commensurate with experience • Health benefits • Paid time off • A structured 90-day onboarding program designed to set you up for success through hands-on coaching, technical immersion, and process training • A defined career path with clear expectations and milestones for advancement • Continued investment in your technical and professional development • Exposure to challenging projects and technologies across a diverse client base • A team that takes the work seriously and each other personally Attention to Detail - Read This We run one of the most thorough hiring processes in our industry on purpose. Our clients trust us with systems, security, data, and businesses they have spent years building. Small details can have significant consequences. We believe attention to detail starts before someone ever joins our team. To apply: Email your resume as a PDF to careers@gotier3.com. Your subject line must read exactly: Senior IT Engineer Application – [Your Full Name] In the body of your email, briefly describe a complex technical problem you solved and how you communicated the resolution to the client or your team.
